subject: Media Literacy
title: Social Proof in Marketing
description: Learn Social Proof in Marketing in one minute.

hook.text: 'Join 10 million happy customers.' You see the number and trust the product without thinking.

buildup.text: Social proof uses the actions of others — reviews, testimonials, popularity — to influence your decision.

discovery.text: Humans are wired to follow the crowd. If others chose it, our brains assume it must be good.

twist.text: Many reviews are fake. Amazon removed over 200 million suspected fake reviews in a single year.

climax.text: Social proof works even when the 'proof' is fabricated. Fake popularity creates real sales.

punchline.text: Not all five-star reviews are real. Some were bought.

quiz.question: Why is social proof effective in advertising?
options: Humans are wired to follow the crowd's choices
